note: Recurring free / discount rules. rule.type: weekly {days:[0-6, 0=Sun]}, monthly {nth, day}, first_full_weekend, always. verified = last date the rule was checked.

deals.title_zh: MoMA 现代艺术博物馆 周五免费夜
deals.who_zh: 纽约州居民,需提前预约并带居住证明
deals.who_en: New York State residents; reserve ahead, bring proof of residency
deals.desc_zh: 每周五晚 5:30–8:30 纽约州居民免费,票数有限,建议提前在官网预约。
deals.desc_en: Free for New York State residents every Friday 5:30–8:30 PM. Limited tickets; reserve online.

deals.title_zh: 惠特尼美术馆 周五免费夜
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每周五晚免费参观;25 岁及以下每天都免费。
deals.desc_en: Free on Friday evenings; visitors 25 and under are free every day.

deals.title_zh: 惠特尼美术馆 每月第二个周日免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每月第二个周日全天免费,常有亲子艺术活动。
deals.desc_en: Free on the second Sunday of every month, often with family programs.

deals.title_zh: 大都会艺术博物馆 随意付费
deals.title_en: The Met: Pay What You Wish
deals.venue: The Metropolitan Museum of Art (Fifth Avenue & The Cloisters)
deals.who_zh: 纽约州居民;纽约州、新泽西、康涅狄格的学生
deals.who_en: New York State residents; students from NY, NJ and CT
deals.desc_zh: 符合条件的访客在售票处出示证件即可按意愿付费,修道院分馆(The Cloisters)同样适用。
deals.desc_en: Eligible visitors pay what they wish at the desk with ID; also applies at The Cloisters.

deals.title_zh: 自然历史博物馆 随意付费(普通门票)
deals.title_en: American Museum of Natural History: Pay What You Wish
deals.address: 200 Central Park West, New York, NY 10024
deals.who_zh: 纽约、新泽西、康涅狄格居民
deals.who_en: Residents of New York, New Jersey and Connecticut
deals.desc_zh: 普通门票随意付费,特展和影院另收费;带娃必去的恐龙馆就在普通门票里。
deals.desc_en: Pay what you wish for general admission; special exhibitions and shows cost extra.

deals.title_zh: 布鲁克林博物馆 随意付费
deals.title_en: Brooklyn Museum: Pay What You Can
deals.who_zh: 所有人(在现场售票处购票)
deals.desc_zh: 现场购票随意付费,网上购票有建议价。每年 2–8 月有免费的 First Saturdays 夜场。
deals.desc_en: Pay what you can at the desk (online has a suggested price). Free First Saturdays run February–August.

deals.title_zh: 布朗克斯动物园 周三免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人,名额有限需提前预约
deals.desc_zh: 每周三免费入园(部分游乐项目另收费),名额有限,提前在官网预约。
deals.desc_en: Free general admission on Wednesdays, limited and by advance reservation.

deals.title_zh: 纽约植物园 周三免费逛园
deals.who_zh: 纽约市居民全天免费(现场凭居住证明);其他人 10–11 点免费
deals.who_en: NYC residents all day (proof of residency, onsite); others 10–11 AM
deals.desc_zh: 每周三园区免费,纽约市居民全天、其他访客上午 10–11 点。
deals.desc_en: Free grounds access on Wednesdays: all day for NYC residents, 10–11 AM for everyone else.

deals.title_zh: Culture Pass 图书馆卡免费博物馆票
deals.venue: 100+ 纽约博物馆和文化机构
deals.who_zh: 纽约公共、布鲁克林、皇后区图书馆持卡人(13 岁以上)
deals.who_en: NYPL, Brooklyn and Queens library cardholders aged 13+
deals.desc_zh: 用图书馆卡在 culturepass.nyc 预约免费日票,每家机构每人每年一次;每月 1 日放出下个月的票,热门场馆抢得快。
deals.desc_en: Reserve free day passes with your library card, one per venue per year; passes release on the 1st of each month.

deals.title_zh: de Young 与荣勋宫美术馆 湾区居民周六免费
deals.title_en: de Young & Legion of Honor: Free Saturdays for Bay Area residents
deals.venue: de Young Museum / Legion of Honor
deals.address: 50 Hagiwara Tea Garden Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118
deals.who_zh: 湾区九县居民,凭居住证明
deals.who_en: Residents of the nine Bay Area counties, with proof
deals.desc_zh: 每周六常设馆免费,需在官网预约分时段门票;特展另收费。
deals.desc_en: Free permanent-collection admission every Saturday with timed tickets; special exhibitions extra.

deals.title_zh: de Young 与荣勋宫美术馆 每月第一个周二免费
deals.title_en: de Young & Legion of Honor: Free First Tuesdays
deals.venue: de Young Museum / Legion of Honor
deals.address: 50 Hagiwara Tea Garden Dr, San Francisco, CA 94118
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周二所有人免费,特展另收费。
deals.desc_en: Free for everyone on the first Tuesday of the month; special exhibitions extra.

deals.title_zh: 亚洲艺术博物馆 每月第一个周日免费
deals.title_en: Asian Art Museum: Free First Sundays
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周日免费参观,常有家庭活动和表演;具体日期以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Free on the first Sunday of the month, often with family programs; confirm dates on the museum site.

deals.title_zh: 奥克兰博物馆 每月第一个周日免费
deals.title_en: Oakland Museum of California: Free First Sundays
deals.who_zh: 所有人(特展另加 $6)
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周日展厅免费,建议提前预约,现场也有先到先得的票。
deals.desc_en: Free gallery admission on first Sundays; reservations encouraged, walk-ups first come first served.

deals.title_zh: Discover & Go 图书馆卡免费博物馆票
deals.venue: 湾区 50 多家博物馆、科学馆、动物园
deals.who_zh: 参与图书馆的持卡人(奥克兰、伯克利、圣塔克拉拉县等)
deals.who_en: Cardholders of participating libraries (Oakland, Berkeley, Santa Clara County and more)
deals.desc_zh: 用图书馆卡在线预约免费或打折门票,每月 1 日放票,热门场馆很快被约满;各图书馆规则略有不同。
deals.desc_en: Reserve free or discounted passes with your library card; passes release monthly and popular venues go fast.

deals.title_zh: 美国银行 Museums on Us 每月第一个完整周末免费
deals.title_en: Bank of America Museums on Us
deals.venue: 参与的博物馆(各城市名单不同,出发前查官网)
deals.who_zh: 美国银行 / 美林卡持卡人,每张卡一人免费,带照片证件
deals.who_en: Bank of America / Merrill cardholders, one free admission per card, with photo ID
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个完整周末(周六+周日)持卡人免费,参与场馆每月可能变化,出发前查官网名单。
deals.desc_en: Free on the first full weekend of each month; participating museums vary, check the list before going.

deals.title_zh: Getty 盖蒂中心 永久免费
deals.address: 1200 Getty Center Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90049
deals.who_zh: 所有人,需预约分时段入场;停车 $25(下午 3 点后 $15)
deals.who_en: Everyone; timed reservation required; parking $25 ($15 after 3 PM)
deals.desc_zh: 门票永远免费,只收停车费;山顶看洛杉矶全景,花园很好拍。
deals.desc_en: Admission is always free; you pay only for parking. Gardens and city views.

deals.title_zh: The Broad 布罗德美术馆 永久免费
deals.address: 221 S Grand Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012
deals.who_zh: 所有人,建议提前预约
deals.desc_zh: 常设展免费,草间弥生无限镜屋要另外排队预约;特展另收费。
deals.desc_en: Free general admission; special exhibitions extra.

deals.title_zh: 加州科学中心 永久免费
deals.address: 700 Exposition Park Dr, Los Angeles, CA 90037
deals.who_zh: 所有人(特展和 IMAX 另收费)
deals.desc_zh: 常设展免费,能看到奋进号航天飞机,带娃必去。
deals.desc_en: Free permanent exhibits, including Space Shuttle Endeavour.

deals.title_zh: LACMA 洛杉矶郡立美术馆 每月第二个周二免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人;洛杉矶郡居民工作日下午 3 点后也免费;郡内 17 岁及以下随时免费
deals.who_en: Everyone; LA County residents also free weekdays after 3 PM; county kids 17 and under always free
deals.desc_zh: 每月第二个周二所有人免费,具体以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Free for all on the second Tuesday of the month; confirm on lacma.org.

deals.title_zh: 亨廷顿图书馆与植物园 每月第一个周四免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人,需提前预约免费票
deals.who_en: Everyone; free tickets must be reserved ahead
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周四免费,票放出后很快约满,中国园流芳园值得一看;以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Free on the first Thursday, advance tickets required; includes the Chinese Garden.

deals.title_zh: Skirball 文化中心 周四免费
deals.address: 2701 N Sepulveda Blvd, Los Angeles, CA 90049
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每周四免费参观展览(诺亚方舟儿童区需另购票)。
deals.desc_en: Free exhibitions on Thursdays (Noah's Ark is ticketed separately).

deals.title_zh: 日裔美国人国家博物馆 周四免费
deals.title_en: Japanese American National Museum Free Thursdays
deals.address: 100 N Central Ave, Los Angeles, CA 90012
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 小东京的日裔美国人博物馆,每周四免费,以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Free on Thursdays in Little Tokyo; confirm on the museum site.

deals.title_zh: OCMA 橙县美术馆 永久免费
deals.title_en: Orange County Museum of Art (always free)
deals.address: 3333 Avenue of the Arts, Costa Mesa, CA 92626
deals.who_zh: 所有人,无需预约(周三至周日 11–18 点)
deals.desc_zh: 新馆免费开放,就在 Segerstrom 艺术中心旁边。
deals.desc_en: Free admission at the new museum next to Segerstrom Center.

deals.title_zh: 拉古纳美术馆 每月第一个周四晚免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周四晚免费,顺便逛拉古纳海滩的艺术街区;以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Free on first Thursday evenings during the Laguna art walk; confirm on the museum site.

deals.title_zh: 巴尔博亚公园居民免费日:Fleet 科学馆、自然历史博物馆
deals.title_en: Balboa Park Resident Free Tuesday (1st): Fleet Science Center, The Nat
deals.who_zh: 圣地亚哥市和县居民、现役军人及家属,带有本地地址的证件
deals.who_en: San Diego City/County residents and active military with dependents; photo ID with local address
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周二,Fleet 科学馆和自然历史博物馆免费(电影和特展除外)。
deals.desc_en: First Tuesday: Fleet Science Center and San Diego Natural History Museum (films and special exhibits excluded).

deals.title_zh: 巴尔博亚公园居民免费日:航空航天博物馆等
deals.title_en: Balboa Park Resident Free Tuesday (2nd): Air & Space and more
deals.who_zh: 圣地亚哥市和县居民、现役军人及家属
deals.who_en: San Diego City/County residents and active military with dependents
deals.desc_zh: 每月第二个周二:航空航天博物馆(1 月闭馆)、退伍军人博物馆、Comic-Con 博物馆(12 月除外)。
deals.desc_en: Second Tuesday: Air & Space Museum (not January), Veterans Museum, Comic-Con Museum (not December).

deals.title_zh: 巴尔博亚公园居民免费日:圣地亚哥美术馆、日本友好庭园
deals.title_en: Balboa Park Resident Free Tuesday (3rd): SD Museum of Art, Japanese Friendship Garden
deals.who_zh: 圣地亚哥市和县居民、现役军人及家属
deals.who_en: San Diego City/County residents and active military with dependents
deals.desc_zh: 每月第三个周二:圣地亚哥美术馆(特展除外)、日本友好庭园(12 月除外)。
deals.desc_en: Third Tuesday: San Diego Museum of Art (special exhibitions excluded) and Japanese Friendship Garden (not December).

deals.title_zh: 巴尔博亚公园居民免费日:汽车博物馆、Museum of Us
deals.title_en: Balboa Park Resident Free Tuesday (4th): Automotive Museum, Museum of Us
deals.who_zh: 圣地亚哥市和县居民、现役军人及家属
deals.who_en: San Diego City/County residents and active military with dependents
deals.desc_zh: 每月第四个周二:汽车博物馆(9 月、12 月除外)、Museum of Us(12 月除外)。
deals.desc_en: Fourth Tuesday: Automotive Museum (not Sep/Dec) and Museum of Us (not December).

deals.title_zh: Kids Free San Diego 十月儿童免费
deals.venue: 圣地亚哥多家博物馆、动物园
deals.who_zh: 12 岁及以下儿童随付费成人免费(各场馆规则不同)
deals.who_en: Kids 12 and under free with a paying adult (rules vary by venue)
deals.desc_zh: 整个 10 月,动物园、博物馆等多个场馆儿童免费,各家人数和年龄规则不同,出发前看官方名单。
deals.desc_en: All October, many museums and the zoo let kids in free with a paying adult; check each venue's rules.

deals.title_zh: 西雅图美术馆 & 西雅图亚洲艺术博物馆 每月第一个周四免费
deals.title_en: SAM & Seattle Asian Art Museum Free First Thursdays
deals.venue: Seattle Art Museum / Seattle Asian Art Museum
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周四两馆都免费,市中心馆开到晚上 8 点;亚洲艺术博物馆在志愿者公园。
deals.desc_en: Both museums are free on the first Thursday; the downtown museum stays open until 8 PM.

deals.title_zh: 飞行博物馆 每月第一个周四晚免费
deals.title_en: Museum of Flight Free First Thursdays
deals.address: 9404 E Marginal Way S, Seattle, WA 98108
deals.who_zh: 所有人,无需预约
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周四晚 5–9 点免费,看飞机和航天飞机训练舱。
deals.desc_en: Free 5–9 PM on the first Thursday, no reservation needed.

deals.title_zh: MOHAI 历史工业博物馆 & Burke 自然历史博物馆 第一个周四免费
deals.title_en: MOHAI & Burke Museum Free First Thursdays
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周四:MOHAI 晚 5–8 点常设展免费,Burke 博物馆全天免费并延长开放。
deals.desc_en: First Thursday: MOHAI permanent exhibits free 5–8 PM; Burke Museum free all day with extended hours.

deals.title_zh: ICA 当代艺术馆 周四晚免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人,建议提前预约
deals.desc_zh: 每周四晚 5–9 点免费,海港边看展看日落;以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Free Thursday evenings 5–9 PM on the waterfront; confirm on icaboston.org.

deals.title_zh: Boston Family Days 学生家庭周日免费
deals.venue: 14 家波士顿博物馆(MFA、Gardner、儿童博物馆等)
deals.who_zh: 波士顿公立学校学生及家人(需领取通行证)
deals.who_en: Boston public school students and their families (pass required)
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一和第二个周日,波士顿学生带家人免费逛 14 家博物馆,包括美术馆 MFA 和 Gardner 博物馆。
deals.desc_en: First and second Sundays: Boston students and families get into 14 museums free, including the MFA and the Gardner.

deals.title_zh: 哈佛艺术博物馆 永久免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 2026 年对所有人免费开放,逛完顺便走走哈佛校园。
deals.desc_en: Free for all visitors throughout 2026.

deals.title_zh: Field 自然史博物馆 伊州居民周三免费
deals.title_en: Field Museum Illinois Resident Free Wednesdays
deals.address: 1400 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
deals.who_zh: 伊利诺伊州居民,带居住证明
deals.who_en: Illinois residents with proof of residency
deals.desc_zh: 2026 年每周三普通门票免费,包括恐龙 SUE 和古埃及展。
deals.desc_en: General admission free every Wednesday in 2026, including SUE the T. rex and Inside Ancient Egypt.

deals.title_zh: MCA 当代艺术馆 伊州居民周二晚免费
deals.who_zh: 伊利诺伊州居民
deals.desc_zh: 全年每周二晚 5–9 点伊州居民免费。
deals.desc_en: Free for Illinois residents Tuesdays 5–9 PM year-round.

deals.title_zh: Shedd 水族馆 秋季伊州居民周二免费
deals.title_en: Shedd Aquarium Illinois Resident Free Tuesdays (fall)
deals.address: 1200 S DuSable Lake Shore Dr, Chicago, IL 60605
deals.who_zh: 伊利诺伊州居民,需提前预约
deals.desc_zh: 9–11 月每周二伊州居民免费,名额有限要提前在官网预约。
deals.desc_en: Free for Illinois residents on Tuesdays in September–November; reserve online.

deals.title_zh: 林肯公园动物园 永久免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人(停车收费)
deals.desc_zh: 全美少数免费的动物园之一,一年四季都可以去。
deals.desc_en: One of the few free zoos in the US, open year-round.

deals.title_zh: 休斯顿美术馆 MFAH 周四免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人(常设展,特展另收费)
deals.desc_zh: 每周四常设展全天免费。
deals.desc_en: Free general admission to the permanent collection on Thursdays.

deals.title_zh: 休斯顿自然科学博物馆 周二傍晚免费
deals.title_en: Houston Museum of Natural Science Free Tuesdays
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每周二傍晚常设展免费,恐龙馆和矿物馆都在里面;具体时段以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Free permanent exhibits on Tuesday evenings; confirm hours on hmns.org.

deals.title_zh: 休斯顿儿童博物馆 周四晚免费
deals.title_en: Children's Museum Houston Free Family Night
deals.who_zh: 带孩子的家庭,需要领取免费票
deals.who_en: Families with a child; free ticket required
deals.desc_zh: 每周四晚 5–8 点免费家庭夜,同行需要有小朋友。
deals.desc_en: Free family night Thursdays 5–8 PM; groups must include a child.

deals.title_zh: 达拉斯美术馆 DMA 普通门票永久免费
deals.title_en: Dallas Museum of Art (free general admission)
deals.who_zh: 所有人,建议网上预约
deals.desc_zh: 普通门票全年免费;每月第一个周日特展也免费(DMA Free First Sundays)。
deals.desc_en: General admission is free year-round; special exhibitions are free on first Sundays.

deals.title_zh: 达拉斯美术馆 每月第一个周日特展免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周日,付费特展也免费,常有家庭活动。
deals.desc_en: Ticketed special exhibitions are free on the first Sunday of each month.

deals.title_zh: Nasher 雕塑中心 每月第一个周六免费
deals.title_en: Nasher Sculpture Center Free First Saturdays
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周六免费,雕塑花园很适合带娃散步。
deals.desc_en: Free on the first Saturday of each month.

deals.title_zh: Crow 亚洲艺术博物馆 永久免费
deals.title_en: Crow Museum of Asian Art (always free)
deals.who_zh: 所有人(周二至周日开放)
deals.desc_zh: 达拉斯艺术区的亚洲艺术博物馆,中国玉器和日本艺术收藏很棒,永久免费。
deals.desc_en: Free museum of Asian art in the Dallas Arts District, open Tuesday–Sunday.

deals.title_zh: SMU Meadows 博物馆 周四傍晚免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每周四下午 5 点后免费,西班牙艺术收藏全美数一数二。
deals.desc_en: Free after 5 PM on Thursdays; major Spanish art collection.

deals.title_zh: 史密森尼博物馆群 & 国家动物园 永久免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人;航空航天博物馆、非裔美国人博物馆等需要提前领免费分时段票
deals.who_en: Everyone; some (Air and Space, African American History) need free timed passes
deals.desc_zh: 国家广场上的十几家博物馆和国家动物园全部免费,热门馆提前一个月在 si.edu 领票。
deals.desc_en: All Smithsonian museums on the Mall and the National Zoo are free; book passes for popular museums on si.edu.

deals.title_zh: 国家美术馆 永久免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 东西两馆和雕塑花园全部免费。
deals.desc_en: East and West Buildings and the Sculpture Garden are free.

deals.title_zh: High 美术馆 每月第二个周日免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 每月第二个周日中午到下午 5 点免费。10 月因 100 周年生日派对改到 10/18。
deals.desc_en: Free on the second Sunday, noon–5 PM. In October it moves to Oct 18 for the 100th birthday celebration.

deals.title_zh: ROM 皇家安大略博物馆 每月第三个周二晚免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人,需提前预约(特展另收费)
deals.desc_zh: 每月第三个周二傍晚免费,恐龙和中国馆都在常设展里。
deals.desc_en: Free general admission on third Tuesday evenings; reservations needed.

deals.title_zh: AGO 安大略美术馆 每月第一个周三晚免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人,需提前预约
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周三晚 6–9 点免费参观常设展;以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Free permanent collection on first Wednesday evenings; confirm on ago.ca.

deals.title_zh: AGO 25 岁以下免费年卡
deals.title_en: AGO free annual pass for under-25s
deals.who_zh: 25 岁以下安大略居民,需先注册年卡
deals.who_en: Ontario residents under 25 who register for the free annual pass
deals.desc_zh: 注册免费年卡后,全年不限次参观常设展。
deals.desc_en: Register for the free AGO Annual Pass for unlimited general admission.

deals.title_zh: 多伦多图书馆 MAP 博物馆免费家庭票
deals.title_en: Toronto Public Library Museum + Arts Pass (MAP)
deals.venue: ROM、AGO、多伦多动物园、Ripley 水族馆等
deals.who_zh: 多伦多公共图书馆持卡人
deals.desc_zh: 用图书馆卡领取家庭免费票,覆盖 ROM、AGO、多伦多动物园、Ripley 水族馆、Aga Khan 博物馆等;数量有限先到先得。
deals.desc_en: Free family passes to the ROM, AGO, Toronto Zoo, Ripley's Aquarium and more with your library card; limited.

deals.title_zh: 温哥华美术馆 每月第一个周五晚免费
deals.title_en: Vancouver Art Gallery Free First Fridays
deals.who_zh: 所有人,建议提前预约;18 岁及以下随时免费
deals.who_en: Everyone, reserve ahead; 18 and under always free
deals.desc_zh: 每月第一个周五傍晚免费,人多建议提前预约。
deals.desc_en: Free on first Friday evenings; popular, so reserve ahead.

deals.title_zh: 温哥华博物馆、海事博物馆、太空中心 每月第一个周日随意捐款入场
deals.title_en: Vanier Park museums: by-donation First Sundays
deals.venue: Museum of Vancouver / Maritime Museum / H.R. MacMillan Space Centre
deals.who_zh: 所有人(建议捐 C$5–20)
deals.desc_zh: Vanier Park 的三家博物馆每月第一个周日按捐款入场,带娃看太空中心很划算;以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Pay by donation at three Vanier Park museums on the first Sunday; confirm on each site.

deals.title_zh: 中华文化中心博物馆 免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人(周二至周日 11–17 点,欢迎捐款)
deals.desc_zh: 唐人街的华人历史博物馆,免费开放。
deals.desc_en: Free museum of Chinese Canadian history in Chinatown.

deals.title_zh: 蒙特克莱尔美术馆 每月第一个周四晚免费
deals.title_en: Montclair Art Museum Free First Thursdays
deals.who_zh: 所有人,需预约免费票
deals.desc_zh: 每年 11 月到次年 6 月,每月第一个周四晚免费,常有主题活动。
deals.desc_en: Free on first Thursday evenings, November–June, with themed programs.

deals.title_zh: 新泽西州立博物馆 永久免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 州府特伦顿的州立博物馆,恐龙化石和天文馆很受小朋友欢迎(天文馆节目另收费)。
deals.desc_en: Free state museum in Trenton with fossils and a planetarium (shows extra).

deals.title_zh: 普林斯顿大学美术馆 免费
deals.who_zh: 所有人
deals.desc_zh: 普林斯顿校园里的美术馆免费开放,新馆建筑本身就值得一看;开放时间以官网为准。
deals.desc_en: Free museum on the Princeton campus; check hours online.
